components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary call to action — square, vermillion, confident.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; background: #eb4928; color: #f8fafc; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d12f15; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2f2f2, 0 0 0 4px #eb4928; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — vermillion on white, square, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; background: #ffffff; color: #eb4928; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: 1px solid #eb4928; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(235,73,40,0.05); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eb4928; }

components.name: On-Vermillion CTA Button
components.description: The CTA button placed on a vermillion band — ink ground, light text.
components.css: .ds-btn-onverm { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; background: #020817; color: #f2f2f2; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 2.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-onverm:hover { background: #0b1326; } .ds-btn-onverm:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #eb4928, 0 0 0 4px #f2f2f2; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Square white content block with a hairline border and a top accent on hover.
components.html:
Capital Raising

Become capital-ready and mobilize growth capital across equity, debt and blended finance.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 0; padding: 2rem; border-top: 4px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.3s ease-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-top-color: #eb4928; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(2,8,23,0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #020817; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(2,8,23,0.78); margin: 0; }

components.name: Ledger Row (signature)
components.description: The full-width ledger row used inside full-bleed bands — title, lead, supporting copy, trailing arrow; divided by hairlines, never boxed.
components.html:
Trade & Growth Advisory

Enter markets and scale across borders.

We help institutions select markets, design entry pathways and scale across African and global markets with commercial precision.
components.css: .ds-row { font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2.5rem; padding: 2.25rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(2,8,23,0.12); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: background 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(2,8,23,0.04); } .ds-row-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-title { font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.875rem; line-height: 1.1; color: #020817; margin: 0; } .ds-row-lead { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; color: #020817; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; } .ds-row-desc { font-weight: 300; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.55; color: rgba(2,8,23,0.75); margin: 0.5rem 0 0; max-width: 42rem; } .ds-row-arrow { color: #eb4928; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 0.5rem; transition: transform 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-arrow { transform: translateX(6px); }

narrative.overview: Credence Africa reads like the working surface of an institution that gets serious things done — a ledger, a prospectus, a signed mandate — not a vendor's pitch deck. Hard right angles, one decisive vermillion, near-black institutional ink, and one geometric sans in light display weights. Authoritative and decisive with pan-African ambition; quiet power over noise. Vermillion is the single instrument of emphasis, deployed in committed full-bleed blocks or as sharp accents, against generous light space and deep navy gravitas.
keyCharacteristics: Zero radius — every corner is square.
One geometric sans (Outfit) in light display weights; hierarchy from scale, not weight.
A single vermillion accent, committed or sharp, never timidly sprinkled.
Near-black navy ink for gravitas; light gray ground for breathing room.
Full-bleed colored bands and full-width hairlines instead of card chrome.

rules.name: The One Vermillion Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent hue. It is either committed (a full-bleed band, 30–60% of a surface) or sharp (≤10%), never a timid sprinkle.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Vermillion Rule
rules.body: Text on a vermillion ground is Ink (#020817), not white — higher contrast and more institutional. White is permitted only on near-black ink bands.

rules.name: The Light-Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 400, never bold. Scale and space create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second font family. Contrast comes from weight (300 ↔ 700) and dramatic scale jumps within Outfit.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation is reserved for the hero box and the conversion CTA.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0 radius).
Do set headings in Outfit weight 400 and create hierarchy with scale and space.
Do commit vermillion — full-bleed bands or sharp accents, deployed with intent.
Do put Ink (#020817) text on vermillion grounds, and use Ink at 70–80% for body on light grounds.
Do separate content with full-bleed color and 1px full-width hairlines.
Do ship real, specific imagery — not generic 'Africa rising' maps or stock skylines.
donts: Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or the big-number hero-metric template.
Don't look like interchangeable Big-4 consulting (stock skylines, corporate blue, glassy gradients).
Don't drift into flashy startup/SaaS, NGO/aid framing, or bureaucratic portal stiffness.
Don't introduce a second font family or bold display headings.
Don't put small vermillion or muted-foreground body text on a light ground; it fails contrast.
